1.consolidated_definition: Planta trepadora de hasta 10 m de altura, con hojas ovaladas, flores de gran tamaño, aromáticas, de color blanco y púrpura, y fruto redondo, amarillento y liso; su pulpa es comestible y de agradable sabor. Passifloraceae Passiflora maliformis.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Climbing plant reaching a height of up to 10 meters, with oval-shaped leaves, large aromatic flowers in white and purple colors, and round, smooth, yellowish fruit; its pulp is edible and has an agreeable taste. Family Passifloraceae, species Passiflora maliformis.
